activity_context.topic_title: The Determinant of an NxN Matrix

feedback.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$H=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 7 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(H) & ={h}_{11}{C}_{11}+{h}_{12}{C}_{12}+{h}_{13}{C}_{13}+{h}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =2\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =2\cdot {C}_{11}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13} \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 7 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & ∗ & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|)-(7\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & =2(0)-(7(-10)) \\  & =-(-70) \\  & =70\end{aligned}
$$
